slow_inference.title: llama-server is too slow for {entities} entities
slow_inference.description:
Loading the device list into the model took {seconds} s (server: {url}). This usually means the CPU has no AVX2, so every voice command will take 30 seconds or more.

Run llama-server on a machine with AVX2 or a GPU and enter its URL via "Reconfigure" on the HA LLM Agent entry, or expose fewer entities to Assist.
